properties.name: feedback.store-type
properties.description: Feedback storage implementation. Supported values: local, dynamo.

properties.name: feedback.admin.username
properties.description: Admin username for feedback admin endpoint HTTP Basic authentication.

properties.name: feedback.admin.password
properties.description: Admin password for feedback admin endpoint HTTP Basic authentication.

properties.name: feedback.local-files.path
properties.description: Filesystem path to the local NDJSON file used by LocalFilesFeedbackStore.

properties.name: feedback.dynamo.table-name
properties.description: DynamoDB table name used by DynamoFeedbackStore.
